content: This is my current roster, I am not sure if I want anything else from the current event banners and what to focus on standard. Is there anything I would regret not pulling now, please advice.

Hiya, just started yesterday. Slammed all my free pulls from codes on caro cause they looked cool. Attached picture of my roster.


1. I have 10 ethereal cores which it looks like I need to spend before the patch in a few days? Wondering the best banner to throw those at. 

2. Should I continue throwing my standard pulls for random characters (if so, what realm?) or should I be pulling for blade of the titan? I pulled one blade already just to have one to try it out.

3. Planning on throwing all my silver at mouchette and GLotan. Good idea? Who would it be better for me to try for first in case I run outta currency before hitting both? Just finished chapter 2 I have 8500 silver and 13 luminous cores.

4. Currently I am running both Helots, Sorel, and Salvador, is there a better lineup to cruise through the story with over the next few days before next patch?

Hello there and welcome aboard : )

1. Indeed.

If you enjoy caro, I recommand pulling for Saya. It will help if you can enlighten her twice but grabbing one copy of her wheel takes priority.

2. You will eventually want 5 functionnal teams and awakeners give you much more flexibility than wheels.
So yeah, I would recommend you pull *in all realms* until you have 19 units you feel comfortable playing with

3. 8 500 silver gives you 42 cores. Add the 13 you already have and that's 55 pulls.
The guarentee is set at 30 pulls and it's likely gonna be another guaranted featured awakener every 3 SSR which means you need 90 cores ( 18 000 silver ) in order to be absolutely sure you get *one* copy of either GLotan or Mouchette.
Mouchette is more of a glass cannon that needs to deal with any enemy early while GLotan seems more posse-oriented and only plays well in full chaos teams.

4. That's a lot of damage there.
You could swap Helot for Saya and call it a day. My preference goes to taking Helot out as well and shoving a Thaïs to feed Saya with aliemus.
aight didn't hit saya off the 10 pulls unfortunately. I'll start using my standard pulls on chaos units then to see if i get something good for glotan
Going through the main chapters and side strories should net you some more pulls and silver if you're short : )
Not sure where the idea that ethereal cores were expiring that soon came from, mine say 30d and 6h in inventory. Not that this is helpful at this stage.
Oh i read somewhere they expire with new patches?

Not every patch. You can see in the inventory (when you have any again) when they say they’ll expire. They seem to be fairly lengthy duration, I believe these were assumed to be lasting until just after the GLotan and Mouchette reruns - so you could have gotten rolls at either of them, but probably not past that as that should take the remaining four weeks past this update.
Here’s a picture of mine just now
I’ve had those since before you started, so I don’t think they would have lasted any longer.
hm
oh well!

Is there like a team building guide anywhere ? I found the newbie guide and it has like character guides but not specific teams . Here's my roster- any ideas for teams? Rn ive been running ghelot aigis and thais and faint mostly.

Hello! First time posting here.

I’ve been playing Morimens pretty casually and mostly pulling characters I like without paying much attention to the meta 😅

Attached are my roster and resources. I’d love some advice on what I should focus on next to make my account stronger.

Any suggestions for teams, characters worth investing in, banner priorities, or general account progression would be greatly appreciated. Thanks!

Welcome back 😄

You seem to like a lot of awakeners 🤭 
Your roster is plenty powerful as is. If I have one advice, it would be getting Saya to e2 for extra embryo generation.

As for the rest, Corpo, Pollux and GHelot all work best with their e3 so ... up to you.

But GLotan and Mouchette are comming soon so it might be worth hoarding some cores for them.

Are you having any difficulty so far ?
Hahaha, I am  a collector so I try to summon for every awakener because I like all their design 🤭, I do have difficulty doing content for lv55 and higher as my awakeners aren’t really built I think
What's your main team ?
These two mainly!
Maybe just try subbing Helot for Saya and see how it goes. She inflicts insane amounts of corrosion which quadruple damage done
As for the chaos team, GLotan is coming soon and would be great with Tawil I think. But she wants a pure chaos linup so maybe switch Caecus for Lily, Alva or even Karen

About Saya : my favorite linup is discard-themed : Saya-Thaïs-Aurita-Corposant
If you like cycling through your deck every turn and playing around with 0-cost cards, it can be fun <:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975>

Hello there and welcome aboard ! Thank you far saving Morimens <:Saya_wow:1513124172895879198> 

From what I see, all I would recommand from the current banners in two more duplicates of Saya.
The first one only improves her shield and corrosion generation but the second one adds embryo generation to her base skills which you will likely need.

Did you check Cheri's Handbook ?
With your roster you should have no issue skimming through the first chapter but feel free to ask if you hit a wall at some point : )

[AT LEAST 160 FREE STANDARD PULLS]

Go to the thread below for helpful Beginner guides and Redemption codes 

https://discord.com/channels/1131791637933199470/1509396840330825758/1509396840330825758
Alright, thanks a lot! Yeah I didn't check her 2nd enlight since most people talk about the first one and the first one didn't seem quite as interesting to me
As for the handbook, I am working through it
Related to the topic if I could get any 1 limited character from astral reign - which one would help my account progression the most?

There's no easy answer to that.
Most would recommend Mouchette because she hits fast and hard ( she reruns on the next banner too ) or Vortice because she builds heavy damages over the course of a fight.

Arachne is a solid suggestion too because her final verdict is a sure way too kill any enemy, provided you can survive long enough.

As for me ... I say it highly depends on your preference. I do have a Mouchette but she collects dust in the dorms for now. Just not my style.

Did you find the trials under the " records " button in the home screen ?
I did find
I was considering Kathigu-Ra after reviewing next version announcement
But I've been also told that she's more of another dps and requires her own team rather than going into an existing comp
As well as like e2 or e3 to play well

Most efficients dps require their enlightenment u.u

But really, you have more than enough at the moment to get you started. I suggest you just go with the game and start cinsidering options when you hit a wall u.u
